checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate assets: 4:5 poster, 9:16 story, 9:16 reel
must.why: Story is 9:16, poster 512x640 (4:5), reel is vertical 9:16.

must.item: Warm lantern imagery and coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design
must.why: All three use the same lanterns, navy sky, gold text and glowing river.

must.item: Each asset includes exact event text
must.why: All five lines are present and correct in all three.

must.item: Reel is 10 s with visible motion
must.why: Frames show lanterns moving and the string shifting between frames; the text stays fixed. The frame at 9.5 s suggests it runs to full length.

must.item: Text legible and unclipped; reel holds details long enough
must.why: The gold text is large, high-contrast and static for the whole reel. The poster shows the lanterns slightly cropped at the edges, which is fine.

faults.what: The poster is lower resolution and its river is cropped to a thin strip. It is slightly less polished than the story image.
The reel motion is subtle: the lanterns drift and the river shimmers a little. The lantern string changes shape between frames.
The time line uses a short dash that looks like a hyphen or en dash.

summary: The pack is a cohesive set of three pieces, each with all five text lines spelled correctly and a readable gold-on-navy layout. The reel has modest lantern motion and holds the text steady.
